purpose: Mechanism-independent Proof-of-Principle acceptance envelope for bottle capture, controlled wrap-axis rotation, label-transfer coherence, reaction support, release, and clearance. This envelope constrains candidate tests but does not select a mechanism or grant mechanical acceptance.

product_binding.dimensional_basis: Encoded in deterministic benchmark part identity; not independently remeasured by this requirement model.

ideal_maintained_frictionless_finite_lin.interpretation: Supports the geometry of five restrained rigid-body DOF with wrap-axis rotation left available in the ideal maintained-contact model only.

current_pose_reference_evidence.limitation: Current-pose tangency and ideal rank do not establish interval-wide maintained contact, preload, compliance, friction, traction, force capacity, reachable motion, mechanism selection, or mechanical acceptance.

must_hold: Exactly one intended bottle is positioned at the application station.
Bottle remains vertically supported and upright.
Flow-position departure is restrained or otherwise intentionally bounded.
Cross-flow position is bounded within an explicit tolerance once that tolerance is sourced.
permitted_motion: Wrap-axis rotation behavior before capture is architecture-dependent and remains unresolved.
failure_observables: Bottle leaves the indexed position unintentionally.
Bottle loses vertical support or upright stability.
Neighbor product occupies or blocks the required capture envelope.

must_hold: A named physical owner establishes the required lateral contact set.
Vertical support remains valid.
Translation flow and cross-flow are restrained or bounded as required.
Tilt about both horizontal axes remains stabilized.
Wrap-axis rotation remains intentionally permitted and controllable.
permitted_motion: Controlled rotation about the bottle upright wrap axis.
failure_observables: Required lateral contact is absent or only exists at an isolated static pose.
Bottle is overconstrained such that wrap-axis rotation is blocked.
Closure owner, travel, limits, or contact-maintenance law is undefined.

must_hold: Capture/contact state remains valid through the transfer interval.
Bottle-to-label-presentation relationship remains coherent.
Vertical support and tilt stability remain valid.
Any bottle translation is intentionally restrained or synchronized.
permitted_motion: Controlled wrap-axis rotation where required by transfer.
failure_observables: Bottle motion invalidates label presentation geometry.
Contact state is lost before transfer completes.
Label-transfer path intersects or is blocked by candidate handling geometry.

must_hold: An equivalent rank-sufficient lateral normal-contact set is maintained.
Tangential rotation drive is explicitly separated from normal closure/contact maintenance.
Reaction loads have an explicit path to fixed support.
Vertical support and tilt stability remain valid.
permitted_motion: Controlled circumferential rotation about the wrap axis.
failure_observables: Contact normal set loses rank sufficiency.
Required traction or reaction path is undefined.
Candidate geometry interferes with CAB hardware, neighbors, mounting, or label path.

must_hold: Capture owner intentionally transitions to an open/release condition.
Bottle retains vertical support and upright guidance.
Exit path becomes available without uncontrolled lateral escape.
Neighbor clearance remains valid.
permitted_motion: Residual wrap-axis rotation behavior remains unresolved until sourced or tested.
failure_observables: Bottle remains trapped after wrap completion.
Release causes uncontrolled fall, lateral escape, or collision.
Open geometry blocks the next product or the exit path.

cross_state_obligations.requirement: Each POP candidate must name the physical mechanism that owns closure/open/release behavior.
Open, capture, wrap-maintenance, and release states must be represented by explicit transforms, constrained motion, or another deterministic motion law.
Required lateral contact must remain valid through the scoped capture/transfer/wrap interval, not just at one static pose.
The required bottle wrap-axis rotation must remain intentionally available while other necessary rigid-body motions are restrained.
Normal closure and contact reactions must have a defined structural path to fixed mounting/support.
Open/capture/release reachable geometry must preserve bottle entry, bottle exit, neighbor clearance, CAB hardware clearance, and label-transfer path.
Tangential traction/rotation input must be explicitly identified separately from normal-force closure.

deterministic_success_observables: Exact candidate component identities and source classifications are bound.
Representative OPEN, CAPTURE, LABEL_TRANSFER, WRAP, and RELEASE states are defined.
Whole-body interference/clearance checks pass at each representative state and along any explicitly modeled swept interval.
Exact B-rep or accepted deterministic evidence supports required contact/tangency at scoped states.
The restrained/permitted DOF pattern remains consistent with the function-first DOF requirement.
Reaction support/mounting is geometrically and structurally traceable to fixed support.
Entry and exit paths remain reachable for the benchmark bottle and neighboring products.
No unresolved quantity is silently replaced by a guessed value.
deterministic_failure_observables: Static-pose plausibility is the only support for maintained contact.
Required contact is lost in a scoped operating state.
Candidate overconstrains the wrap-axis rotation or leaves an unintended rigid-body escape mode.
Open or release state blocks product flow.
Whole-body interference appears with product, CAB hardware, neighboring product, stop, mount, or support.
Reaction path terminates in floating or unbound geometry.
Candidate requires an unverified friction, force, stiffness, preload, travel, or tolerance value to pass.
